chapter: Quincy Jones, films and harmonica heroes
title: Armstrong as first blue note contact
summary: A brief exchange on whether Armstrong was his first contact with the blue note.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So, that first blue note came from Louis Armstrong, right?
That was the first… that was that first contact with it.
Well, I don’t know if he was… Oh, I know I was [burning?] with Shearing at the… Oh, [white Dutchy?], that’s me. Can you [inaudible]?

Excuse me, but I don’t know. But you heard how I was playing, and that’s… and with Shearing and… I was burning, you know. And that’s three, two, three years later than what you heard with Benny, you know. So whether that touched one way or the other, or whether Armstrong though, oh, there’s another of those guys… They [unintelligible] hit many notes. I don’t know. But he called me Bop Chops. [laughs] That I know.
